movelist.name: Iron Defense
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Dragon Tail
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 6 meters minus their Weight Class. On a roll of 15+, the target is also Tripped.

movelist.name: Breaking Swipe
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is lowered 1 CS.

movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Hone Claws
movelist.effect: The user’s Accuracy is raised by +1, and the user gains +1 Attack Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Rock Smash
movelist.effect: Rock Smash lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

abilities.name: Light Metal
abilities.effect: The user’s Weight Class is decreased by 2. Their Speed Base Stat is increased by +2, but their Defense Base Stat is decreased by 2.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.effect: The user’s Weight Class is increased by +2. Their Defense Base Stat is increased by +2, but their Speed Base Stat is decreased by 2.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.effect: The user’s Combat Stages may not be lowered by the effect of foes’ Feautres, Abilities, or Moves. Status Affictions may still alter their Combat Stages. Defensive.
